BiblicalUsage: Eliam is an Israelite. In 2 Samuel 11:3, the text says "the daughter of Eliam." The life behind the name is told on the Eliam People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eliam matters because God knows His people by name, and Eliam is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
